card.title: WINTER REGIMENT
card.text: Fully repair this unit when it Salvages a unit.
card.flavorText: The 227th Infantry Regiment was a unit of the 37th Division (nicknamed Winter Division) of the Imperial Japanese Army. Originally the division was a garrison force tasked with maintaining order in occupied northern China, but it swiftly transitioned to frontline combat duties due to the Second Sino-Japanese War, where it engaged the Chinese communist Eighth Route Army in Shanxi Province. The Winter Division was reassigned to the 12th Army in March 1944 and played a significant role in Operation Ichi-go, the Japanese offensive in China, where it advanced through Henan and Guangxi provinces, and eventually occupied Nanning. Further orders led the division south into French Indochina where it was made ready to counter any potential British invasion from Burma. The division survived the war relatively intact and gained recognition for its discipline and officer leadership. After being stationed in Thailand until the end of the war, the 37th Division's troops were transported back to Japan and the division was inactivated shortly afterwards.
